column1: # The expected warnings of MSSQLPlanWarnings on the plans capture.sh takes (captured/<case>.<src>.sqlplan), one line per
# case and input; written before the capture and before the test. Columns (tab-separated):
#   case       the capture's case name (capture.sql's '--@case' line)
#   src        the plan read: cache (dm_exec_text_query_plan), est (SET SHOWPLAN_XML) or qs (sys.query_store_plan)
#   in         the inputs, space-separated: ctp=<cost threshold for parallelism> (- = 0, the five ctp rules not judged),
#              now=+<n>d (LastUpdate of the plan's newest statistic plus n days; - = zero, stale_stats not judged),
#              rt=bc (the runtime numbers of the case's row in captured/blitzcache-8.34.tsv) or
#              rt=<k>:<v>,... with k in stmt exec cpu rows writes spill compile (stmt: the statement the numbers belong
#              to; ms, rows, 8 KB pages); rt=- = none
#   raise      codes the warnings must hold (comma-separated; - = none required); code@<n> = on statement n of the
#              document (MSSQLWarning.Stmt); a line naming a statement is not run again on the Query Store plan
#   not        codes they must not hold (code@<n> = not on statement n)
#   notjudged  codes the not-judged list must hold
#   rows       the check numbers the line proves (MSSQLWarning.Row)
#   note       the side of the threshold, or the trial the capture settles
